title: amber iman IS a goddess confirmed 👑 #publictheaterny #goddessmusical ...
transcript: last night I saw Goddess at The Public Theater and I cannot stop thinking about it it's the kind of show that immediately pulls you in and wraps you up in its world the storytelling the music the choreography are just so vibrant based on an African folktale and set in a nightclub in Mombasa Goddess which is currently in previews at the Public Theater is about a mysterious and ethereal singer who shakes up the lives of everyone she meets specifically Omari the son of the governor of Mombasa who was caught between his parents expectations and fighting for what he believes in it's about love and destiny and the power of humanity the set and the lighting are just stunning and the choreography feels like its own character Austin Scott is one of the performers that lights up the whole stage like he is ridiculously charming and Amber Iman has this stage presence where you cannot look away I think I cried during every single one of her songs also shout out to the puppetry one of my favorite parts of the show goddess is really just so special and it's running at the public until June 8th that was incredible so good if you love Lore folktale any of that you're gonna love it it's so beautiful Amber her voice so you know Amber can sing my god so good austin Scott so good everyone the choreography I couldn't find anything that I didn't like I loved it so much yeah okay go see goddess at the public
